threat_event: Business email compromise: an attacker takes over the owner's mailbox (no MFA) and steals client tax documents from email and cloud folders, then files fraudulent returns or sends requests from the firm's address
threat_source: Cybercriminal group targeting tax professionals (credential phishing)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No MFA on the mailbox, which is also the suite administrator; password reused on practice management and stored in the printer-scanner; years of attachments kept; no review of sign-ins or forwarding rules; phishing near miss on 2026-03-09
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-03 email and files; BP-01 to BP-03
existing_controls: Business-plan suite with provider encryption; laptop antivirus
treatment_plan: Scan-to-folder replaces scan-to-email; MFA on the mailbox and block basic sign-in; password manager with unique passphrases; monthly review of sign-ins and rules; phishing training; P08 runbook

threat_event: Refund diversion: a request from a client's hijacked mailbox changes the direct deposit account or address on a return before it is filed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No call-back rule; change requests accepted by email; near miss on 2026-02-09 stopped only by the owner's own phone call
treatment_plan: POL-01 call-back rule: any change to bank account, address, or email is confirmed by phone on the number on file before filing; tell clients in the 2027 engagement letter that the firm never accepts bank changes by email

threat_event: Ransomware or an information-stealing malware on the laptop encrypts files, steals local client documents, and harvests saved browser passwords (including accountant logins to client accounting files)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Laptop is the only workstation; local downloads with no backup; passwords saved in the browser; no security training
existing_controls: Full-disk encryption; automatic updates; built-in antivirus
treatment_plan: Password manager instead of browser storage; keep client files in the suite with a backup service, not in downloads; training; P08 steps for a compromised laptop

threat_event: Client documents are exposed in transit or at the edges: plain email attachments, returns emailed on request, and text-message photos that sync to a personal photo backup account
threat_source: Owner error, client error, or interception
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Portal used by only about 35% of clients; client portal MFA optional; no rule against email or text; photos stay in the camera roll
existing_controls: Provider TLS on connections; phone passcode
treatment_plan: Portal-only exchange of returns and source documents; required client portal MFA; remove client photos from the phone and photo backup; client letter before filing season

threat_event: A forgotten user account in the tax software (the 2025 contract preparer's) is used to view client returns or file under the firm's EFIN
threat_source: Former contractor, or an attacker who obtains that account's password
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No account review; no offboarding step; account active 15 months after the engagement ended (P07 finding, disabled 2026-07-29)
existing_controls: Vendor-enforced MFA on every account; account disabled 2026-07-29; vendor audit log shows no sign-in after 2025-04-14
treatment_plan: Quarterly user review; disable on the last day of any engagement; weekly EFIN and PTIN return counts in filing season (Pub. 4557)

threat_event: Client tax return information is disclosed to the generative AI assistant's vendor without an IRC 7216 basis, and may be used to improve its models
threat_source: Owner use of an unapproved tool (service provider)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No IRC 7216 analysis or consent; individual plan terms; model-improvement setting on until 2026-07-27; full SSNs on 12 uploaded documents
existing_controls: Client data stopped, setting off, and chats deleted 2026-07-27
treatment_plan: No client tax return information in the tool; counsel reviews past uploads and any future consent route; adopt only a tool with business terms that fit IRC 7216 (P10)

threat_event: An AI-generated error (a nonexistent citation or an omitted figure) reaches a filed return or an IRS notice response
threat_source: AI output error not caught at review
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No written review rule for AI output before 2026-08-31; two errors found in July, both caught
existing_controls: Owner reviews every return and letter before it goes out
treatment_plan: Check every citation against the primary source and reconcile every AI summary to the source form totals (P10 section 5)

threat_event: A service provider mishandles client data or is the path for an attack (IT consultant's remote-support account, practice management vendor, AI vendor)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No vendor list; IT consultant had no terms or IRC 7216 notice until 2026-07-23; consultant's tool account MFA unconfirmed; vendor terms unreviewed
existing_controls: Owner starts and watches every remote session; agreement and notice signed 2026-07-23
treatment_plan: Vendor list with data and contract dates; confirm the consultant's MFA; annual review of the tax software vendor's SOC 2 report

threat_event: The CPA-owner is suddenly unavailable in filing season (illness or injury) or loses the only phone, so nobody can file returns or extensions or reach clients
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One person holds every role and credential; tax software second factor on one phone; no recovery codes; no continuation agreement
treatment_plan: Sealed recovery codes with the owner's attorney (2026-09-30); continuation agreement with another CPA, with counsel's IRC 7216 advice (2026-12-31); second authenticator; vendor procedure for extensions (P05)

threat_event: Old files make any breach larger: electronic records back to 2014 and paper back to 2019 for about 1,450 consumers, many no longer clients
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No retention or disposal schedule; IRS authorizations for about 40 former clients never withdrawn
treatment_plan: Written retention schedule (keep Forms 8879 at least 3 years); first purge after the 2027 filing season; withdraw old authorizations

threat_event: A compromised family or smart-home device on the shared home network attacks the laptop or printer-scanner, or someone changes the router settings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One network for the office and the family; default router admin password; firmware never checked
existing_controls: SaaS traffic uses TLS; laptop host firewall on
treatment_plan: New router admin password; firmware update; family and smart-home devices on the guest network

threat_event: Email and file data is lost to ransomware sync, deletion, or account lockout, with only 30 days of version history and no backup of laptop files
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No backup beyond the suite's 30-day version history
existing_controls: Suite version history; tax software vendor backs up returns
treatment_plan: Encrypted backup service for the suite with one-year retention; keep client files in the suite, not on the laptop

threat_event: A data theft is not recognized quickly, or the IRS next-business-day report, the FTC 30-day notice, or the Florida 30-day notice is missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident plan or contact list; owner did not know the Pub. 1345 and Florida clocks; no security training
treatment_plan: Adopt and print the P08 runbook and contacts; record the IRS Stakeholder Liaison number; walkthrough with the IT consultant before filing season

threat_event: The laptop or phone is lost or stolen with client information on it
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Phone holds client document photos and the email app; laptop holds downloads
existing_controls: Laptop full-disk encryption; phone passcode and encryption
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low because both devices are encrypted. Turn on remote wipe for the phone; photo cleanup is tracked under R-004

threat_event: A hurricane or long power or internet outage closes the home office during filing season
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single location; paper files on site
existing_controls: SaaS reachable from anywhere over the phone hotspot; extensions available
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. Take the laptop, phone, and the paper files in progress when a storm watch is issued; work from another location
